archival_memory.user_profile: Managing wealth is a discipline just like running an investment firm. While my day job is focused on institutional finance, my personal portfolio is a different game. I take a long-term approach, balancing high-risk opportunities with stable, income-generating investments. Equities and private equity make up the core, but I also hold a mix of bonds, real estate, and alternative assets. I don't chase trends—I look for asymmetric upside. If an opportunity doesn't have a significant margin of safety or a compelling growth narrative, it doesn't make it into my portfolio. The goal isn't just wealth accumulation; it's capital preservation and strategic growth.
